description: Erection of a rear dormer; raising the ridge of the front main roof involving a front extension at second floor level; insertion of rooflights to the front and rear roof slope
decision_conditions: <p>All new external facing and roofing materials in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance.</p><p>REASON: To conserve the character of the host dwelling.</p>

<div>Within 1 month of the completion of the development hereby approved, the applicant shall provide adequate evidence of installed bat boxes. Evidence shall include details and full specifications of 2 bat boxes, which shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include a minimum of 2 bat boxes incorporated into the design of the development. Boxes should be placed at or close to the eaves level of the development and at least 4m above the ground. The boxes should be placed away from artificial light sources and ideally located near dark tree lines or hedgerows where possible. The boxes should be located facing south, southeast or southwest, and exposed to sun for part of the day.</div><div><br>The details hereby approved shall be delivered, in full, prior to the first occupation of the development and shall be maintained for the lifespan of the development</div><div><br></div><div>Reason: To support bat populations in Hackney and preserve endangered urban biodiversity, by providing nesting opportunities, in accordance with Hackney’s Local Plan LP33 policy LP47.</div><div><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"></div>
